card.name: Aircraft flight testing and operations
card.fires_on: Words in aircraft and missile-defense passages just before a flight-related word is expected, such as 'first' before 'flights' or 'to' before an action by a plane. The text is aviation news, not drug labels.

modes.label: Before 'flights'
modes.description: Words leading up to the noun 'flights' or 'flight testing' in aircraft development histories.
modes.example: conducted their<< first>> flights in February and June of that year

modes.label: Airborne laser plane context
modes.description: Linking words like 'to' in talk of an airborne laser aircraft getting into position or deploying.
modes.example: in order to be able<< to>> shoot down that missile in the boost phase

card.writes: It pushes toward flight words such as flew, flying, flown and flight.
card.plain: It fires in aircraft stories when the next word is likely to be about flying.
